* [Report this job](https://www.linkedin.com/uas/login?fromSignIn=true&session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fjobs%2Fview%2Fstaff-engineer-production-planning-factory-strategy-at-tesla-4487092333&trk=public_jobs_ellipsis-menu-semaphore-sign-in-redirect&guestReportContentType=JOB&_f=guest-reporting)
**What To Expect
** Tesla is seeking a Staff Engineer lead Production Planning, Factory Strategy planning, and high-impact Special Projects across Energy manufacturing.
This role is responsible for driving planning alignment and execution across MFCA and MFTX, ensuring factory plans are executable, risks are surfaced early, and strategic initiatives translate into on-the-ground results.
In this role, you will lead and coordinate the teams responsible for production planning, labor planning and factory strategy at both sites, owning planning cadence, cross-site alignment, and execution discipline.
You will partner closely with Production, Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, Quality, Design, Manufacturing Engineering and Commercial teams to balance near-term execution with longer-term factory readiness, ramps, and cost-down priorities.
**What You'll Do
**- Lead production planning execution across MFCA and MFTX, owning build plans, replans, and planning cadence across short- and mid-term horizons to meet volume, cost, and delivery targets
- Manage and coordinate factory strategy planning for both sites, supporting capacity ramps, line readiness, downtime strategy, new programs and long-range planning in alignment with demand and POR assumptions
- Lead special projects that drive optimization cut across Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and Quality, including ramp readiness, throughput recovery, cost-down initiatives, and execution risk burn-down
- Identify risks to production output, clear-to-build, labor, tooling, or materials, and drive cross-functional mitigation plans to set up the programs for long term success. closure
- Develop and maintain planning tools, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms that improve visibility, accountability, and decision-making for factory and leadership teams while driving innovation and standardization to continue scaling the business
- Partner with senior leaders to surface tradeoffs, evaluate scenarios, and enable timely, high-confidence decisions that materially impact factory performance and long-term strategy
**What You'll Bring
**- Degree in Engineering, Operations, or equivalent practical experience
- 7+ years of experience in manufacturing, operations, or factory planning
- Demonstrated success owning multi-program or factory-level initiatives in high-ambiguity environments
- Strong analytical background with experience in production planning, capacity modeling, or operational finance
- Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to influence critical decisions and align cross-functional teams
- Proven ability to operate independently, define problems, and deliver outcomes that scale beyond individual contribution
- Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-pressure environments while managing multiple competing priorities
**Benefits
** Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:
- Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
- Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
- Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
- Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
- Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
- 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
- Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
- Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
- Employee Assistance Program
- Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
- Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
- Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
- Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
- Tesla Babies program
- Commuter benefits
- Employee discounts and perks program
- Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)
, Tesla

**What To Expect
** Tesla is seeking a hands-on Manufacturing Engineer to take end-to-end ownership of manufacturing systems in Palo Alto, CA — from pioneering prototype processes in R&D to designing, optimizing, and scaling them for high-volume, highly automated production.
You will invent and rapidly iterate novel processes and prototype equipment, then lead their translation into robust automation integrating robotics, machine vision, precision mechatronics, and intelligent controls.
You will drive process development, equipment specification and qualification, line design, vendor management, optimization, validation, technical transfer, and continuous improvement while collaborating closely with Product Design, Controls, Quality, and Operations teams.
Success requires creative first-principles thinking, rapid prototyping capability, and rigorous data-driven execution.
**What You'll Do
**- In-house development of workstations, manufacturing equipment, and fixtures to support early-stage alpha/beta prototype builds
- Identification and documentation of manufacturing bottlenecks during R&D to influence high-volume equipment design
- Design, specification, procurement, construction, integration, and deployment of automated assembly equipment, robotics, inline vision systems, precision gauging, and end-of-line testing for medium- and high-volume production
- Development of new bespoke manufacturing processes from R&D through high-volume automation
- Design of production workstations for ergonomics, efficiency, and throughput
- Performance of process analysis, DOE, PFMEA, Process Flow Diagrams, control plans, line balancing, and capacity modeling
- Early Design for Manufacturing (DFM) collaboration with Product Design teams to influence product architecture for high-volume manufacturability
- Training of technicians and line operators in new manufacturing processes and equipment
- Leadership of data driven continuous improvement initiatives to improve yield
- Ownership of project timelines and technical transfer from development through steady-state production
**What You'll Bring
**- Experience developing mechanical equipment, fixturing, and tooling in a 3D CAD environment (SolidWorks, CATIA)
- Proven hands-on experience building early-stage functional prototypes and temporary bridge tooling
- Demonstrated success transitioning novel processes and equipment from low-volume R&D/prototype stages into high-volume, 24/7 automated manufacturing environments
- Experience introducing new equipment and new processes into a production environment
- Strong working knowledge of statistical data analysis, root-cause methodologies, DOE, and process optimization tools
- Knowledge of manufacturing fundamentals, mechanical design principles, and Design for Manufacturability (DFM)
- Excellent cross-functional communication skills with proven ability to manage technical requirements with international machine builders and vendors.
**Benefits
** Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:
- Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
- Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
- Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
- Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
- Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
- 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
- Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
- Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
- Employee Assistance Program
- Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
- Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
- Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
- Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
- Tesla Babies program
- Commuter benefits
- Employee discounts and perks program
- Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)
Expected Compensation
$109,600 - $195,600/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits
Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Current CVG employees, please click **HERE** to login and apply.
Position Summary
The Operations Manager – Aftermarket reports directly to the US National Seating Plant Manager and Alabama Operations for the Seating division. This role is responsible for leading all operational activities supporting the Commercial Vehicle Group’s commercial vehicle seating aftermarket products.
The role works closely with leaders across Supply Chain, Customer Service, Sales, Engineering, Finance, and Manufacturing. The Operations Manager typically leads warehouse supervisors, logistics coordinators, inventory specialists, and distribution personnel responsible for supporting aftermarket service operations.
Key Responsibilities
**Customer Service & Order Fulfillment
**
* Ensure aftermarket customers receive accurate and on-time deliveries to minimize fleet downtime.
* Support fast turnaround of critical replacement components for dealers and fleet maintenance operations.
* Monitor service metrics including order fill rate, on-time delivery, backorder levels, and order cycle time.
* Partner with customer service and sales teams to resolve escalations and urgent service part requirements.
**Inventory & Supply Chain Management
**
* Manage inventory levels of replacement seats, seat mechanisms, cushions, suspensions, armrests, seat tracks, and related components.
* Partner with CVG procurement, planning, and supply chain teams to ensure consistent availability of critical service parts.
* Implement inventory control processes including cycle counting, inventory accuracy audits, and obsolescence management.
* Assist plant leadership team to optimize warehouse layout and material flow to efficiently store both large seat assemblies and smaller service components.
**Operational Leadership
**
* Lead operational activities supporting the aftermarket distribution of CVG commercial vehicle seats, seat components, and service parts.
* Ensure timely processing, picking, packing, and shipment of orders to OEM service networks, dealers, distributors, and fleet customers.
* Develop operational strategies that support growth of CVG’s aftermarket business.
* Monitor operational performance and implement corrective actions when necessary.
**Financial Performance
**
* Manage operational budgets associated with aftermarket distribution and logistics.
* Identify opportunities to reduce freight, packaging, and warehouse operating costs.
* Support overall profitability of CVG’s aftermarket business through effective inventory and operational strategies.
**Team Leadership
**
* Lead and develop warehouse, logistics, and inventory personnel supporting aftermarket operations.
* Collaborate with the Operations Managers
* Establish clear performance expectations related to safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and operational excellence consistent with CVG leadership expectations.
**Safety & Compliance
**
* Maintain safe warehouse and distribution operations in compliance with all safety standards.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of seat assemblies and components to prevent product damage.
* Promote a safety-first culture throughout the facility.
**Qualifications
** **Education
**
* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field preferred.
**Experience Required
**
* 5+ years of manufacturing leadership experience.
* Experience in commercial vehicle, heavy truck, automotive, bus, or industrial equipment environments strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting OEM aftermarket service parts networks or distribution operations highly preferred.
* Experience managing or working in direct partnership with internal warehouse, distribution, or service parts fulfillment operations highly preferred.
* Experience working in ERP-based supply chain systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms.
**Preferred Industry Experience
**
* Commercial vehicle seating systems
* Heavy truck components or interiors
* Automotive seating manufacturing
* Aftermarket service parts distribution
* Fleet service support operations
* OEM supplier environments
**CVG IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Any unsolicited information sent to CVG will be considered as unencumbered and free from any fee or charge whatsoever. Only members of our Human Resources Team have the authority to engage or authorize recruiting services, which must be agreed upon before any resume or offer is received.

** Commercial Vehicle Group (CVG) makes no representations or guarantees regarding employment opportunities listed on any third-party website. To protect against career scams, job applicants should take the necessary precautions when interviewing for and accepting employment positions allegedly offered by CVG.
